key_findings: Scripted ResearchBrain tool loop produced Stage-0 source-backed hypothesis artifacts only.
limitations: Deterministic fake/scripted agent slice; no live LLM, live web, WFA, MT5, or profitability validation.

claims_extracted: Order flow analysis can indicate buyer/seller imbalance that often precedes market reversals.
Price tends to move toward areas of substantial liquidity (strong resistance/support).
Imbalance between aggressive buyers and sellers creates directional price moves that can be observed on intraday timeframes.
limitations: Blog post is educational content, not peer-reviewed research.
General conceptual framework rather than specific MT5 implementation details.
disconfirming_relevance: FTMO blog may not contain novel or proprietary mechanism.
Order flow signals require tick data not always available in standard MT5 feeds.
Conceptual description lacks precise entry/exit rules for deterministic validation.

hypothesis_packets.mechanism: Cumulative delta divergence from tick volume on M15-H1 identifies session-boundary liquidity sweeps where order-flow imbalance precedes directional reversal or continuation.
hypothesis_packets.falsifiable_prediction: On FTMO MT5 symbols, tick-volume cumulative delta divergence on M15-H1 correlates with subsequent price direction more often than random assignment in post-hoc labeling of liquidity sweeps at session transitions.
hypothesis_packets.market_structure_assumption: Order-flow imbalance visible in tick-volume cumulative delta precedes price reversals at identifiable liquidity zones near session boundaries.
hypothesis_packets.instrument_scope: FX majors EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY and indices US30 US100 GER40 on FTMO/MT5.
hypothesis_packets.required_data: MT5 tick volume for selected symbols OHLCV M15-H1 bars session timestamp labels London-New York overlap.
expected_failure_modes: Tick volume may not reflect true order flow across brokers
Spread costs during high-impact news can overwhelm edge
False signals during overlapping low-volatility periods
invalidation_criteria: Average adverse move exceeds average favorable move in validation sample
Signal generation rate below 1 per week on any symbol
Correlation between cumulative delta divergence and subsequent price direction not distinguishable from random walk
Spread costs regularly exceed 50% of average favorable move magnitude
hypothesis_packets.implementation_shape: Rule-based: rolling cumulative delta from tick volume; detect divergence between price and delta; filter by London-New York overlap session; trail stop to recent swing extreme.
hypothesis_packets.execution_sensitivity: Spread-sensitive ECN conditions preferred; swap-sensitive for holds beyond daily roll; session timing critical London-New York overlap only.
hypothesis_packets.mt5_ftmo_concerns: FTMO challenge lot-size limits and consistency rules constrain position sizing; tick volume may lack true order-book depth in standard MT5; no DOM data available.
prior_related_lessons: Use only deterministic captured source artifacts as evidence provider-native knowledge is not evidence
prior_failed_patterns_checked: No blocking failed-pattern match returned by check_failed_pattern_similarity
hypothesis_packets.novelty_reason: FTMO educational blog on order flow has not been formally operationalized as a quantitative cumulative-delta divergence strategy for MT5 backtesting this hypothesis specifies concrete rule-based implementation rather than conceptual analysis.
disconfirming_evidence: FTMO blog is educational marketing content not peer-reviewed research
No quantitative backtesting data provided in source
Order flow analysis is widely discussed and may not yield novel edge
Tick volume data quality varies by broker
hypothesis_packets.proposed_experiment_shape: Backtest on 12+ months of MT5 tick volume for EURUSD M15 with defined divergence entry rules trailing stop and session filter measure directional consistency and cost impact excluding profitability terms.
